claims.promise: The musician can take or choose a whole set of score-page photographs, then order, rotate, replace or remove pages before making the document, instead of being limited to a one-page trial.

evidence.finding: The 100K+ install mid-tier de.halbestundeuben.app drew the Play-rendered critical-review excerpt: "Take the picture of one page of the music sheet and that's it. Your privilege to try another pa"; the excerpt was printed by node scripts/scan-complaints.mjs --package de.halbestundeuben.app.

claims.deferredReason: No import flow exists; proof requires a test that imports several image URIs through PickMultipleVisualMedia and preserves a user-edited page order.

claims.promise: Each score page is auto-cropped, perspective-corrected, rotated and contrast-adjusted, but the musician sees and can correct every proposed crop before the PDF is made rather than trusting optical note recognition to invent notation.

evidence.finding: The 500K+ install PlayScore2 app com.organum.playscore drew the excerpt: "It is still very flawed. It will get notes and rhythms wrong constantly." printed by node scripts/scan-complaints.mjs --package com.organum.playscore; its scan asks users to trust recognition accuracy.

claims.deferredReason: No image pipeline exists; proof requires fixture-image tests for rotation and a UI test that changes a crop before rendering the final page.

claims.promise: The ordered, cleaned pages become one print-ready PDF that the musician can share, save through the system file picker, or hand to a print app; the transformed artifact is not an archive trapped inside the app.

evidence.finding: The inference follows the lane's required handoff and the measured one-page restriction on the 100K+ mid-tier app; the sampled reviews did not directly ask for PDF export, so export demand is not claimed as measured.

claims.deferredReason: No document path exists; proof requires a PdfDocument export and ACTION_SEND intent test whose output contains every ordered page.

claims.promise: The cleanup and export session contains no ads and no subscription: one purchase unlocks unlimited page sets for the life of the install.

evidence.finding: node scripts/enrich-market.mjs --query 'sheet music scanner app' --top 8 --concurrency 3 measured seven of eight enriched cards with IAP, while node scripts/scan-complaints.mjs --query 'sheet music scanner app' --top 6 --concurrency 2 classified 8 of 12 critical reviews as paywall.

claims.deferredReason: No product surface exists; proof requires no advertising SDK, no subscription product, and a test that the export flow has no ad or renewal state.
